post.description: Online only. Purchases follow web roles vendedor/admin/adminEmpresa/superAdmin; transfers follow inventario/admin/adminEmpresa/superAdmin. Current device and branch context enforced. Reuse exact operation_id and payload on ambiguous replies. Purchases compute totals server-side; payment uses current expected_debt. Transfer creation does not move stock; destination reception is atomic and idempotent, with FIFO lots.
